description: A repository class for managing calendar events, leaves, and astrology details using Room database in an Android application. It provides methods to retrieve, add, and convert data entities related to calendar events, leaves, and astrology details.

classes.name: RoomCalendarRepository
classes.description: Repository class implementing CalendarRepository, handling data operations for calendar events, leaves, and astrology using Room database.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Retrieves a list of calendar events for a specified month and year.

methods.name: addEvent
methods.description: Adds a new calendar event to the database.

methods.name: getAstrologyDetails
methods.description: Fetches astrology details for a specific date.

methods.name: addAstrologyDetails
methods.description: Inserts astrology details into the database.
